business_problem: FlutterFlow's products utilize Firestore's native real-time sync features to enable collaboration at production scale for teams building together
solution_summary: Persistent Firestore state powers AI-native workflows across FlutterFlow MCP, FlutterFlow Test Mode, and FlutterFlow Designer FlutterFlow MCP lets developers bring any AI agent (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Codex) directly into the FlutterFlow canvas. Firestore carries the context those agents need between sessions. The agent that knew the codebase yesterday knows it today: not because it was briefed again, but because Firestore held the real-time state. FlutterFlow Designer, the AI-native visual design tool, uses Firestore for real-time multiplayer collaboration. Multiple designers, developers, and AI agents work on the same canvas simultaneously, with changes across users synced instantly. As software shifts from specifications to prompts, data models have to evolve just as quickly. Firestore's flexible document model handles changing data naturally, without schema migrations, downtime, or operational overhead slowing product development.
